# ASIG 0.5.0 accessibility evidence

This record covers the shared catalogue and framework-neutral packages. It does not claim
that ERP, OpenCAD, or Marketing adapters conform before those products repeat the checks in
their own routes, data, permissions, and workflows.

## Automated evidence

The release candidate must pass these commands on Node.js 26 before publication:

```sh
npm run check
npm test
```

The browser suite covers:

- Axe checks across Operations, Operations Dark, CAD, and Marketing themes;
- the shared 44 CSS-pixel hit-target contract and visible keyboard focus;
- the new data view switcher's immediate `aria-pressed` state and polite status update;
- keyboard behavior and focus management for menus, dialogs, tabs, pagination, sidebar,
  checkbox, radio, switch, searchable picker, and sortable tables;
- outside-pointer and focus dismissal for menus, plus Escape focus restoration;
- 320 CSS-pixel reflow, enhanced text spacing, 200 percent text sizing, and intermediate
  responsive layouts without page-level horizontal overflow;
- forced-colors, reduced-motion, and reduced-transparency fallbacks;
- type-aware sorting for every meaningful table column; and
- full-page visual baselines at 375, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS pixels on macOS and Linux.

Results recorded on 2026-09-04:

- focused 375px, 320px, and enhanced-text-spacing regression run: 3 passed, 0 failed;
- `npm test`: 90 passed, 18 intentional cross-project skips, 0 failed;
- macOS visual baselines: regenerated and verified at all four widths;
- Linux visual baselines: regenerated and verified at all four widths in the pinned
  Playwright 1.62.1 Linux environment; and
- package contents: validated by `npm pack --dry-run` for both public packages as part of
  `npm run check`.

An automated pass is regression evidence, not a WCAG conformance declaration.

## Manual verification

| Check | Status for this candidate | Reviewer evidence required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keyboard-only navigation and visible focus | Automated coverage complete; final human review pending | Confirm order, visibility, view-switcher state, menu dismissal, and focus return in a supported browser. |
| Light and dark visual review | Completed 2026-09-04 | Catalogue review approved action hierarchy, switcher behavior, confirmation dialogs, data displays, and responsive layouts. |
| 200 percent text and 400 percent zoom equivalent | Automated coverage; human review pending | Confirm no lost content or functionality in a supported browser. |
| Forced colors and reduced motion/transparency | Automated coverage; human review pending | Confirm meaning and boundaries remain visible with OS preferences enabled. |
| Screen reader and browser combination | Pending human review | Test names, roles, states, announcements, reading order, picker active option, and dialog focus with VoiceOver/Safari or another supported combination. |

Do not describe this release or any consuming product as accessibility-complete until the
pending human checks are dated and signed off by a reviewer. Any failure must identify the
affected criterion, owner, mitigation, and planned removal date.
